name: Henan Dayou Energy Co., Ltd
summary: Henan Dayou Energy Co., Ltd engages in raw coal mining activities in China. It is also involved in washing, processing, and wholesale of coal. The company offers long flame, coking, lean, washed, and gas coal for use in various industries, including chemical, power generation, industrial boilers, and power plants. It also provides coal transportation services; technical and consulting services; water intake, water supply, and heating services; and equipment and house leasing services, as well as engages in domestic and foreign trade activities.
